facts.value: A wide variety of foods, including a variety of fruits, vegetables, pulses, wholegrains and lean sources of protein, help ensure a healthy diet.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: Diverse diets, based on a wide variety of foods, between and within food groups, are associated with a greater likelihood of meeting vitamin and mineral requirements and reduced risk of diet-related noncommunicable diseases.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: For many adults, a shift towards more plant-based sources of protein may bring health benefits, particularly when the shift is away from red meat.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: Foods high in unhealthy fats, free sugars and sodium should be limited.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: Diets containing significant amounts of highly processed foods, which are often high in sodium, sugar or unhealthy fats, are associated with negative health outcomes.
